chapter: New York, the Lafayette and the Cotton Club
title: Paying 60 cents to hear Fletcher Henderson in Cleveland
summary: Arriving in Cleveland with $1.60, Crawford spends 60 cents to hear Fletcher Henderson's band with Coleman Hawkins.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: I'll never forget them as long as I live. And bands --

In Cleveland I spent my last -- I hit Cleveland from Lakeside, Ohio, with $1.60 in my pocket. I think I told you that prior. And I paid 60 cents to go in and hear that great Fletcher Henderson's band, Coleman Hawkins on tenor saxophone. And I just had to see that band. So that left me with a dollar. After I ate, that left me with sixty cents.
I lived three days on that sixty cents. That's a fact.
